enableDialog.title: Enable AI Feature Notice
enableDialog.line1: Enabling AI features means you accept potentially unstable Agent behavior. After enabling, please restart the core — the system will load dependencies using **approximately 200MB of memory**. After restart, continue with configuration; you must also **configure a persona** before using AI features.
enableDialog.line2: To save token consumption, do not extend the persona scope to all group chats.
enableDialog.line3: **Passive Perception** in **Memory Settings** will consume a large number of tokens, as all messages are analyzed in the background to generate a memory graph.
enableDialog.line4: You must configure a **web search service** for the Agent to retrieve the latest information.
enableDialog.line5: The blacklist/whitelist in **Advanced Settings** takes effect globally and takes priority over persona configuration.
enableDialog.line6: To view this notice again, click the **Usage Help** button in the top right corner.
enableDialog.line7: It is recommended to use a **remote Qdrant service** for better performance and stability. You can download Qdrant from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/qdrant/qdrant/releases) and run it directly, or use the [Qdrant Cloud](https://cloud.qdrant.io/) hosted service.

disableDialog.title: Disable AI Feature Notice
disableDialog.line1: To fully release AI feature resource usage, it is recommended to restart the core immediately after disabling.
